name: Japanese Minimal (Ma)
tagline: The space between things is part of the design.
description: A system built on ma, the meaningful interval. Washi paper tones, sumi ink, one hanko red, hairline rules, vertical labels, and generous asymmetric space. Nothing is decorated that does not need to be.

palette.role: hanko red: stamps, the primary action, the selected state

do: Leave at least as much empty space as content in every section, placed asymmetrically
Use one vertical label per screen with writing-mode vertical-rl for a section name
Separate with 1px hairline rules instead of boxes
Use the hanko red for one stamp, the primary action and the selected state only
Keep body text at 16px with a line height of at least 1.8
dont: Do not use shadows or rounded corners, except the round hanko stamp
Do not center whole layouts; anchor them to one side
Do not use more than one red element per section
Do not use bold weights for body text
Do not add decorative patterns like waves or cherry blossoms

components.name: Button
components.notes: Primary is a hanko red fill with paper text; secondary is a 1px edge outline; ghost is text with a hairline underline. Generous horizontal padding, no radius.

components.name: Input
components.notes: Bottom edge only in the edge token, label in Zen Kaku Gothic above, serif input text. Error shows a red short rule and a quiet message.

components.name: Select
components.notes: Bottom edge only with a thin chevron, like a handwritten form line.

components.name: Checkbox and toggle
components.notes: Square 1px edge checkbox with a red check. Switch is a thin line track with a small square that moves and turns red when on.

components.name: Badge
components.notes: Small Zen Kaku Gothic labels with a hairline frame; one round hanko-style badge in red.

components.name: Card
components.notes: A ceramic piece: tall token-drawn bowl shape on paper, name in Mincho, glaze and size in small gothic, price.

components.name: Navbar
components.notes: Wordmark with a small red square seal, links spaced widely, one red reserve action. Mobile menu is a details disclosure with tall rows.

components.name: Modal and sheet
components.notes: Paper sheet with a hairline frame, a vertical label on the side at md, two actions.

components.name: Table
components.notes: Seasonal tea course or opening hours table with hairline rows and lots of row height.

components.name: Bento grid
components.notes: Asymmetric: one tall tile with a drawn tea bowl, a season note, a vertical label tile, hours, and an empty breathing tile.

components.name: Empty state
components.notes: A single circle outline, one quiet sentence, one text action.

components.name: Toast
components.notes: A hairline bar with a small red square and a short message.
